request: Have a Quit message ask an idle worker to poll its inbox repeatedly until everyone finishes, so shutdown stays responsive without parking the receiver.

source.request: Have a Quit message ask an idle worker to poll its inbox repeatedly until everyone finishes, so shutdown stays responsive without parking the receiver.
source.settled: Quit means terminate, and worker messaging uses blocking receive instead of the final heuristic spin-loop.
source.why: Turning Quit into a polling phase reverses both immediate termination semantics and the replacement of spinning with blocking receive.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
